'''Gorlan''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gorsh system/Legends|Gorsh system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] with one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
